mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.project_id AS projectId, p.name AS projectName FROM project p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.company_id = #{companyId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tax_invoice ti JOIN settlement_block sb ON sb.settle_id = ti.settle_block_id JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id WHERE st.project_id = p.project_id AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL AND sb.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND ti.company_id = #{companyId} ) ORDER BY p.name ASC

SELECT type AS type, total_amount AS totalAmount, tax_amount AS taxAmount, issued_no AS issuedNo, buyer_name AS buyerName FROM tax_invoice WHERE tax_id = #{taxId} AND company_id = #{companyId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT settleId, roundName, projectName, plannedAmount, plannedTaxAmount, plannedDate, traderName, amountMatchType, taxAmountMatchType, traderMatchType, dateMatchType FROM ( SELECT sb.settle_id AS settleId, b.title AS roundName, p.name AS projectName, sb.planned_amount AS plannedAmount, sb.planned_tax_amount AS plannedTaxAmount, sb.planned_date AS plannedDate, sb.trader_name AS traderName,
sb.tax_invoice_due_date AS taxInvoiceDueDate, CASE WHEN sb.planned_amount = #{totalAmount} THEN 'EXACT' WHEN sb.planned_amount BETWEEN #{totalAmount} * 0.95 AND #{totalAmount} * 1.05 THEN 'SIMILAR' ELSE NULL END AS amountMatchType, CASE WHEN sb.planned_tax_amount = #{taxAmount} THEN 'EXACT' WHEN sb.planned_tax_amount BETWEEN #{taxAmount} * 0.95 AND #{taxAmount} * 1.05 THEN 'SIMILAR' ELSE NULL END AS taxAmountMatchType, CASE WHEN sb.trader_name = #{buyerName} THEN 'EXACT' WHEN sb.trader_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{buyerName}, '%') OR #{buyerName} LIKE CONCAT('%', sb.trader_name, '%') THEN 'SIMILAR' ELSE NULL END AS traderMatchType,
CASE WHEN sb.tax_invoice_due_date = #{issuedNo} THEN 'EXACT' WHEN DATEDIFF(sb.tax_invoice_due_date, #{issuedNo}) BETWEEN -7 AND 21 THEN 'SIMILAR' ELSE NULL END AS dateMatchType FROM settlement_block sb JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id AND b.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id JOIN project p ON p.project_id = st.project_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE sb.deleted_at IS NULL
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tax_invoice ti2 WHERE ti2.settle_block_id = sb.settle_id AND ti2.deleted_at IS NULL ) AND sb.type = #{type} AND p.company_id = #{companyId} ) candidates WHERE amountMatchType IS NOT NULL OR taxAmountMatchType IS NOT NULL OR traderMatchType IS NOT NULL OR dateMatchType IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (CASE WHEN amountMatchType IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN taxAmountMatchType IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN traderMatchType IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN dateMatchType IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
taxInvoiceDueDate IS NULL ASC, ABS(DATEDIFF(taxInvoiceDueDate, #{issuedNo})) ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT type AS type, total_amount AS totalAmount, issued_no AS issuedNo, settle_block_id AS settleBlockId, is_excluded AS isExcluded FROM tax_invoice WHERE tax_id = #{taxId} AND company_id = #{companyId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT sb.type AS type, sb.status AS status, sb.planned_amount AS plannedAmount FROM settlement_block sb JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id AND b.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id JOIN project p ON p.project_id = st.project_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE sb.settle_id = #{settleId} AND sb.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.company_id = #{companyId}
SELECT settle_id FROM settlement_block WHERE settle_id = #{settleId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT tax_id FROM tax_invoice WHERE settle_block_id = #{settleId} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT sb.settle_id AS settleId, b.title AS roundName, p.name AS projectName, ti.linked_by AS linkedBy, e.name AS linkedByName, ti.linked_at AS linkedAt FROM tax_invoice ti JOIN settlement_block sb ON sb.settle_id = ti.settle_block_id JOIN block b ON b.block_id = sb.block_id JOIN step st ON st.step_id = b.step_id JOIN project p ON p.project_id = st.project_id JOIN employee e ON e.user_id = ti.linked_by WHERE ti.tax_id = #{taxId} AND ti.company_id = #{companyId}
SELECT tax_id AS taxId, memo AS memo, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM tax_invoice WHERE tax_id = #{taxId} AND company_id = #{companyId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT tax_id AS taxId, settle_block_id AS settleBlockId FROM tax_invoice WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND tax_id IN
#{id}
